about_subtitle: Discover the passion, simplicity, and craftsmanship behind HOTMIX.
about_mission_desc: To create timeless, elegant, and modern clothing for women that combines daily comfort with effortless style.
about_vision_desc: To be Morocco's leading modern fashion destination for women seeking minimalism, quality fabrics, and versatile wardrobes.
about_val_quality_desc: Carefully chosen fabrics designed for durability, comfort, and luxurious feel.
about_val_style_desc: Versatile designs crafted to elevate your daily look for any occasion.
about_val_service_desc: Dedicated support team ensuring a seamless shopping and delivery experience.

faq_subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about orders, shipping, and returns.
shipping_subtitle: Everything you need to know about our fast nationwide delivery in Morocco.
shipping_fast_desc: We deliver to all major cities in Morocco including Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, Agadir, Fes, and more.
shipping_payment_desc: Cash on Delivery (COD) & Bank Transfer available. You pay when you receive your order.
shipping_inspection_desc: You have the right to check your package upon arrival before making payment to ensure complete satisfaction.
returns_subtitle: We want you to love your purchases. Read our easy return and exchange process.
returns_window_desc: You may request a return or exchange within 7 days of receiving your order.
returns_cond_desc: Items must be unworn, unwashed, unused, and in their original packaging with all tags attached.
returns_step1: 1. Contact our WhatsApp support team with your Order Number.
returns_step2: 2. Specify the new size or item you would like to receive.
returns_step3: 3. Our courier will deliver the new item and collect the return.
privacy_subtitle: How we protect and handle your personal information at HOTMIX.
privacy_sec1_desc: We collect personal details such as your name, delivery address, phone number, and email when you place an order or interact with our site.
privacy_sec2_desc: Your data is used strictly to process orders, coordinate shipping, provide customer support, and send order status notifications.
privacy_sec3_desc: We implement industry-standard encryption and security measures. Cookies are used to improve browsing experience and remember your preferences.
privacy_sec4_desc: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting support@hotmix.ma.
